note: Four games from the printed procedure: player 1 wins, player 2 wins, player 1 fouls, player 2 fouls, each begun with the re-set button (pb3 pressed and released). Wires are the printed 51 unchanged: no erratum changes a wire. ER-46 is prose only (cover the dial with an inverted box, or add dummy connections to the rotary switch, so players cannot anticipate the start signal); the dummy connections are optional and unspecified, so none is added and errata_applied is empty. Power-on is not in the printed procedure; the script turns power on and pushes re-set at once. Start dial position D0 is the construction state, not printed. When lights 3 and 4 come on after re-set is not printed (programs.json printedUnprinted), so the START asserts are until steps with a 10 s window (several revolutions even at 25 rpm). Win presses come 200 ms after START; in each win game the second player also presses 100 ms later, as both players try. Foul presses come 200 ms after re-set is released, while the dial is still far from the start contact; the lights-3-and-4-off precondition at those presses is not asserted (not stated as an observable). Not asserted, left to Step 7 as derived: the loser's win light staying dark after a late press, lights 3 and 4 staying dark after a foul ('the game must be begun again'), the dial stopping after a win or foul, and which dial contact gives START. Confidence verified: all 51 wires were image-read against a 300 dpi render of PDF p.66 by the author and independently by the round-1 fidelity reviewer, and match the printed list exactly; every asserted observable is quoted from that page. Rotary geometry, run rate and coast remain profile fallbacks.
